acceptance_results.evidence: git status in the seeded run directory shows no change after the run; the memo asserts the clean work tree.

All three named risks handled concretely: invalidation split into auth-token versus entitlement responsibility with session introspection/epoch checks and versioned cache-key rules; drift bounded by shadow comparison over policy revision and fact versions with a four-way cause classification and a zero-unexplained-ALLOW-drift gate; audit continuity via a durable journal written before any authoritative ALLOW, decision_id/evaluation_id dedupe, and explicit cutover markers (last monolith authority, first service authority, revision watermark).

Fixed cohorts with no mid-request or result-based fallback — rejected explicitly because induced failures could downgrade to the more permissive legacy evaluator; post-ownership-transfer rollback keeps the writer in the new service to avoid reverse dual-writes; break-glass confined to a short-lived audited procedure.
